name: The Narrows from the bottom up
why: Wading up the Virgin River between walls 300 m high and in places only 6 m apart, to the dark slot of Wall Street.
book: No permit as far as Big Spring. Park shuttle to stop 9, Temple of Sinawava. Closed when the river runs over 150 cfs (often in spring) and on a flash flood warning. Outfitters in Springdale rent canyoneering boots and a stick.
water: Carry 2 litres: river water must be filtered and can carry toxic cyanobacteria.
dangers: Flash floods: check the flash flood potential at the visitor centre, leave at any rise or muddy water.
Cold water and slippery round stones: closed-toe shoes and a stick.
turnaround: Turn at Big Spring at the latest, or when the water rises or turns muddy.

points.name: Temple of Sinawava
points.note: Shuttle stop 9, start of the paved Riverside Walk.

points.name: End of the Riverside Walk

points.name: Wall Street
